summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (0.96% of shares outstanding), ¥250M upper limit, open-market purchase on TSE, Jun 17–Jul 17, 2026. Rationale: flexible capital allocation and shareholder returns amid changing business environment.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Allied Telesis Holdings announced on June 16, 2026 a board resolution authorizing acquisition of up to 1,000,000 treasury shares (0.96% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for an aggregate limit of ¥250 million. The shares will be purchased on the Tokyo Stock Exchange via open market trading between June 17 and July 17, 2026 (settlement basis). The company states the buyback is undertaken to enable flexible capital allocation and enhance shareholder returns in response to changes in the business environment.
